correctness.rationale: At each axial cycle the first variation of every token dot product vanishes, making attention weights constant to first order. Both exact one-step Jacobians and their symmetric/antisymmetric spectra follow, with a negative unnormalized vertical coefficient separately ensuring genuine sign flips. Each full two-step Jacobian is the square of the one-step tangent matrix by global odd symmetry. The larger eigenvalue supplies the exact if-and-only-if hyperbolic sink criterion; the split criterion automatically implies the synchronized one. The symbolic characteristic-polynomial checker and direct-map derivative comparisons were executed successfully. Boundary multiplier one is not called attracting.

originality.rationale: Inspected original model statement and portions of its equilibrium theory, inspected published summaries of larger-step discussion, compared a distinct negative-definite repulsive self-attention paper, and performed targeted indexed research, published literature and implication searches. The present theorem determines a precise joint parameter boundary and two Floquet spectra for distinct locally attracting nonstationary orbits when the value spectrum has opposite signs; the inspected preceding theorems address equilibria, continuous-time flow, or the different V=-I regime. Full later sections of the directly motivating paper remained intermittently inaccessible, so absolute priority is not claimed and that risk is identified.

value.rationale: The exact joint inverse-temperature/residual-step boundary identifies coexistence of two distinct nonstationary sink types in the minimal two-token model despite a positive principal value eigenvalue.
